summary: The glucose data shows variability with a good time in range (TIR) of 86.0%. Basal rates and target glucose levels are adjusted throughout the day. SMB/UAM is enabled and plays a significant role in glucose control.

analysis_steps.findings: Good CGM coverage with minimal gaps.
analysis_steps.evidence: CGM coverage is 98.7% with 10 gaps, the largest being 65 minutes.

analysis_steps.findings: Generally safe with good TIR, but instances of hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
analysis_steps.evidence: TIR is 86.0%, TAR is 8.9%, and TBR is 5.1%.

analysis_steps.findings: Basal rates and target glucose levels show variability.
analysis_steps.evidence: Basal rates vary throughout the day, and target glucose levels are adjusted.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Some uncertainty around the effect of basal rates during meal times.

analysis_steps.findings: CR and ISF settings are defined and seem generally appropriate.
analysis_steps.evidence: CR varies between 10.5 g/U and 13.2 g/U, ISF is 56 mg/dL/U, and DIA is 10 hours.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into effectiveness during specific meal times.

analysis_steps.evidence: SMB is always enabled, and UAM is enabled.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Uncertainty around SMB/UAM interaction with meal boluses.

analysis_steps.findings: Dynamic ISF is enabled, and max basal/IOB limits are set high.
analysis_steps.evidence: Autosens is disabled, Dynamic ISF is enabled with 70% adjustment.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Effectiveness and safety of high max IOB limit.

analysis_steps.findings: No explicit meal bolus strategy is declared.
analysis_steps.evidence: No carb_treatment_entries or explicit meal strategy declarations.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Lack of direct information on meal bolus strategies.

analysis_steps.evidence: No e-carb entries or extended carb treatments.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into meal absorption patterns.

analysis_steps.findings: Primary recommendation is to review and adjust basal rates for improved glucose control.
analysis_steps.evidence: Variability in glucose levels and basal rate settings.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Uncertainty around meal bolus strategies and SMB/UAM interaction.

issues: Lack of explicit meal bolus strategy

recommendations.title: Review and adjust basal rates
recommendations.description: Adjust basal rates to improve glucose control, especially during overnight periods.

profile_recommendation.recommendation: Adjust basal rate at 00:00 to 0.55 U/h.
profile_recommendation.rationale: To improve glucose control during overnight periods.
profile_recommendation.next_check: Verify glucose levels during the next overnight period.

parameter_decisions.rationale: To improve glucose control during overnight periods.
SMB/UAM is effective in managing glucose variability.

meal_strategy_summary.suggestion: Rely on SMB/UAM for managing meal-related glucose variability.
meal_strategy_summary.rationale: No explicit meal bolus strategy is declared, and SMB/UAM is active.
meal_strategy_summary.next_observation: Monitor glucose levels after meals to assess SMB/UAM effectiveness.

exceptions.pattern: Temporary targets are used in certain situations.
exceptions.suggestion: Review SMB/UAM effectiveness during these periods.
exceptions.rationale: Temporary targets may indicate a need for adjusted glucose management strategies.

education: Importance of monitoring glucose levels closely after adjustments.
safety_notes: Make changes one at a time and monitor glucose closely.
